scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.start: node -e "const express = require('express'); const app = express(); app.use(express.static('./artifacts/shri-ram-nursery/dist/public')); app.get('*', (req, res) => res.sendFile('index.html', { root: './artifacts/shri-ram-nursery/dist/public' })); app.listen(8080, () => console.log('🚀 श्री राम नर्सरी सर्वर पोर्ट 8080 पर चालू हो गया है!'));"
